# software-engineering

> A `std`-only Rust crate, with minimal dependencies, of software-engineering
> metrics: one module per topic (flow, DORA, DevEx, code quality, cost,
> reliability, security, AI-assisted development, and metrics-program
> maturity), each implementing the formulas and worked examples from one
> chapter of the book *Software Engineering Metrics*. Functions are `f64`
> (or a small `Copy` enum for category values), return `Option<f64>`
> wherever a denominator could be zero, and never panic. A handful of
> financial functions (in `technical_debt`, `return_on_investment`, and
> `unit_economics`) additionally have a currency-checked `_money` variant
> built on [`rusty-money`](https://crates.io/crates/rusty-money)'s `Money`
> type, returning `Result<_, rusty_money::MoneyError>` instead of `Option`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install instructions, quickstart, module index by theme
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): build/lint/test commands, architecture, conventions, how to add a module
- [Spec index](spec/README.md): per-module formula and public-API contract
- [llms.json](llms.json): the same module/function index as this file, machine-readable

## Modules — flow metrics

- [flow_framework](spec/flow_framework.md): flow velocity, flow distribution, flow time, flow load, Little's law, flow efficiency
- [cycle_time](spec/cycle_time.md): the five-stage cycle-time breakdown (coding, pickup, review, test, deploy)
- [queueing_theory](spec/queueing_theory.md): utilization and queue stability
- [lean_value_stream_metrics](spec/lean_value_stream_metrics.md): percent complete and accurate, rolled throughput yield, takt time
- [pull_request_metrics](spec/pull_request_metrics.md): time to first review, reviewer load concentration
- [dora_metrics](spec/dora_metrics.md): deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, recovery time

## Modules — developer experience

- [space_framework](spec/space_framework.md): the five SPACE dimensions and coverage checks
- [developer_experience_metrics](spec/developer_experience_metrics.md): focus time, survey response rate
- [satisfaction_metrics](spec/satisfaction_metrics.md): eNPS-style satisfaction score, satisfaction trend
- [activity_metrics](spec/activity_metrics.md): commit-splitting gaming signal, activity rate as context only

## Modules — code and quality

- [code_complexity](spec/code_complexity.md): McCabe cyclomatic complexity
- [test_effectiveness](spec/test_effectiveness.md): test coverage, mutation kill rate
- [code_churn](spec/code_churn.md): code churn, hotspot score
- [technical_debt](spec/technical_debt.md): debt carrying cost — plain `f64` and `Money`-typed
- [static_analysis_metrics](spec/static_analysis_metrics.md): findings per KLOC, severity-weighted finding score
- [documentation_and_knowledge_metrics](spec/documentation_and_knowledge_metrics.md): bus factor, documentation coverage

## Modules — product and business

- [escaped_defects](spec/escaped_defects.md): escaped defect rate, severity-weighted score
- [feature_adoption](spec/feature_adoption.md): initial adoption, retained adoption
- [unit_economics](spec/unit_economics.md): unit cost, cost-component split — plain `f64` and `Money`-typed
- [return_on_investment](spec/return_on_investment.md): ROI and ROI as a range — plain `f64` and `Money`-typed
- [customer_and_business_outcome_metrics](spec/customer_and_business_outcome_metrics.md): net revenue retention, honestly-scoped outcome claims

## Modules — reliability, operations, and security

- [error_budget](spec/error_budget.md): error budget and burn rate
- [incident_metrics](spec/incident_metrics.md): MTTD, MTTA, MTTR, mean duration
- [on_call_metrics](spec/on_call_metrics.md): on-call paging concentration
- [vulnerability_management](spec/vulnerability_management.md): severity levels, vulnerability time-to-remediate

## Modules — AI-assisted development and metrics programs

- [ai_assisted_development](spec/ai_assisted_development.md): net cycle-time change, genuine vs false productivity gain
- [maturity_model](spec/maturity_model.md): minimum and average maturity scoring across dimensions
